eyebrow: The patterns that eat triage time
code:
Known internal scanner  -> looks like SSH brute-force
Scheduled backup job     -> looks like impossible travel
Dev/test sandbox         -> relaxed rules trip real-looking alerts

# Document WHY each one is benign. Never suppress
# the whole finding type on a single confirmed case.
caption: Narrow, documented suppression — not a blanket dismissal of the alert type.

code:
1. Read the alert: resource, severity, MITRE tactic
2. Check grouping: incident / related findings?
3. Establish blast radius
4. Rule out false positive WITH EVIDENCE
5. Decide: contain / monitor / escalate
6. Correlate against CloudTrail / Activity Log
caption: A repeatable sequence, not a one-off judgment call per alert.
